title: Shadows of the Peninsula - Haunts, Pirates and Death Ghost Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Travelers below the age of 14 are not allowed to join this tour.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: When you have a long history like Charleston does, some bad things are going to happen. Our goal is to provide stories of murder and mayhem, but our guides will also give you the stories of those you may not have heard of before. Going deeper into the history of those who died and still haunt the peninsula of Charleston
